idea-plugin.name: UUID Insert
idea-plugin.description:
Insert UUIDs directly into your editor with a single keyboard shortcut (Alt+Shift+U).

Flexible format configuration via three settings:

  • Case — upper or lower case
  • Delimiter — replace dashes with any character(s) (up to 2), e.g. -, _, or empty for no dashes
  • Braces — wrap the UUID with any character(s) (up to 2), e.g. {}, [], ||, or empty for none

Configure under Tools → UUID Plugin.

If text is selected, the UUID replaces the selection — all in a single undoable operation.

action.description: Insert UUID at current cursor position
